title: Record when shipments and migrations change, and stamp every order log line
description: Housekeeping on what the records and the log say about time. A shipment now carries `updatedAt` beside `bookedAt`, so a shipment row reads like an order row, and the migrations table records `ranAt` for each migration it has applied. Every log line that names an order now carries the order's `status` and the `at` it was last written, so a line can be read against the store without going to it; the worker's failure lines name the order id outright. `packhouse show` prints the order's shipment beside it, `packhouse stuck` prints when each order last changed, and the confirmation email says the date the order was placed. No flow changes; the sweep and webhook tests check the stamps.

commit.subject: Timestamp shipments, migrations and the order log lines
commit.body:
Shipment.updatedAt beside bookedAt; ranAt on each applied migration;
status and at on every log line that names an order; the shipment in
packhouse show and the last change in packhouse stuck; the order date
in the confirmation email.
